trigger.condition: MappedSatelliteAdapter.Start receives falsey Conductor before Signal/Graph setup.

likelyCauses.text: MappedSatelliteAdapter.Start receives falsey Conductor before Signal/Graph setup.

diagnostics.action: Inspect mapped Start Conductor presence/truthy flag only.
diagnostics.expected: Redacted flags identify this exact guard without telemetry payload.

correction.boundary: Conditional originating construction/input proposal only; no telemetry/provider execution.

steps.action: Supply intended nonnull Conductor for authorized mapped Satellite construction.
steps.expected: Conductor is present; setup/runtime remains separate.

stopWhen: Canonical mapped/concrete adapter and activity or exact message differs.
Effective telemetry, graph, Token or Conductor owner cannot be identified with redacted metadata.
Proposed action would expose response/entries/token or execute telemetry/REST/conduction/provider effects.

verification.action: Conductor is present; setup/runtime remains separate.
verification.expected: Local guard would be false; telemetry success unverified.

entries.redaction: Exclude Plan/ItemSignal, telemetry body/entries/raw response/errors, counts/keys, token, URL/REST receipt, graph, Conductor/Jacket and exception text; retain canonical adapter/activity, exact message and presence/type/guard flags only.
limitations: HandleResponse can retain Result true in a failed Signal when counts match but errors are logged; do not equate Result with success.
